models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.description: OpenAI's latest frontier agentic coding model. Best for complex code changes, research, polished documents, and ambitious long-horizon work. Supports ultra reasoning for automatic task delegation. 372k token context.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.description: Balanced GPT-5.6 model for everyday agentic coding and professional work. Strong default choice when you want newer GPT-5.6 capability with a more efficient profile than Sol. 372k token context.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.description: Fast and affordable GPT-5.6 model for lighter agentic coding, high-volume tasks, and quick iteration. 372k token context.

models.label: GPT-5.5
models.description: Previous frontier model for complex coding, computer use, knowledge work, and multi-step agentic workflows. Delivers better results with fewer tokens than GPT-5.4.

models.label: GPT-5.4
models.description: Frontier model for professional work with state-of-the-art coding, computer use, and tool search. Incorporates GPT-5.3-Codex's industry-leading coding capabilities. 1M token context.

models.label: GPT-5.4 Mini
models.description: Fast, cost-efficient model for lighter coding tasks and subagents. More than 2× faster than GPT-5.4 while improving on coding, reasoning, and image understanding.

models.label: GPT-5.3 Codex Spark
models.description: Real-time coding model at 1000+ tokens/second. Highly capable small model optimized for near-instant response on ultra-low latency hardware. Text-only, 128k context. Research preview.

models.label: GPT-5.3 Codex
models.description: Most capable agentic coding model from the previous generation, combining Codex and GPT-5 training stacks. Deprecated for ChatGPT sign-in; may remain available via API-key authentication.

models.label: GPT-5.2
models.description: Previous generation baseline. Deprecated for ChatGPT sign-in; may remain available via API-key authentication where newer models are unavailable.

models.label: Gemini 3 Pro
models.description: Google's most capable Gemini 3 model. Best for complex reasoning, agentic coding, and multi-step workflows. Used by the "Auto (Gemini 3)" router for hard prompts. 1M token context.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview)
models.description: Next-iteration Gemini 3 Pro, rolling out in preview. Select manually via /model if your account has access. Improved reasoning and agentic performance over Gemini 3 Pro.

models.label: Gemini 3 Flash
models.description: Gemini 3 Pro-level reasoning at Flash speed and cost. Generally available. Configurable thinking levels and multimodal input with adjustable media resolution. 1M token context.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (Preview)
models.description: Fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini 3 series model. 2.5× faster time-to-first-token and 45% higher output speed vs Gemini 2.5 Flash. Designed for ultra-low latency, high-volume tasks.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.description: Previous-generation hybrid reasoning model. Toggle thinking on or off with a configurable thinking budget. Fast multimodal with text, image, video, and audio input. 1M token context. Used as a fallback by the Auto router.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
models.description: Lightweight, high-throughput variant of Gemini 2.5 Flash optimized for cost-efficient, high-volume workloads with minimal latency.

models.label: Claude Fable 5
models.description: Anthropic's most powerful, most intelligent model — a new tier above Opus. Best for the hardest reasoning, long-horizon agentic, and knowledge-work tasks. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.description: Anthropic's most capable generally available model, succeeding Opus 4.8. State-of-the-art long-horizon agentic execution, complex reasoning, and knowledge work. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8
models.description: Previous-generation Opus. State-of-the-art long-horizon agentic execution, knowledge work, and memory; clearer, warmer writing. Same request surface as Opus 4.7. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.description: Best combination of speed and intelligence in the current Claude lineup. Fast, cost-efficient upgrade over Sonnet 4.6 for everyday coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Supports adaptive thinking with high default effort and xhigh/max for harder workloads. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.7
models.description: Previous-generation Opus. Highly autonomous; strong on long-horizon agentic work, complex reasoning, vision, and memory. 1M token context.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Balanced intelligence and speed. Supports adaptive thinking for deeper reasoning. 1M token context. Recommended for most everyday workflows.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.description: Fastest and most cost-efficient Claude model. Matches earlier Sonnet performance on coding, computer use, and agent tasks. 200k token context.

models.label: Qwen3-Coder
models.description: Qwen's coding-specialized model family (Qwen3-Coder series), optimized for agentic coding in the terminal. Recommended for codebase understanding and multi-step coding tasks via qwen-code.

models.label: Qwen Max
models.description: Qwen's most capable flagship model. Best for complex reasoning, professional tasks, and high-accuracy requirements.

models.label: Qwen Plus
models.description: Balanced inference quality, cost, and speed between Qwen Max and Qwen Flash. Supports thinking and non-thinking modes. Tracks the current Plus generation (Qwen3.6-Plus).

models.label: Qwen Turbo
models.description: Legacy model, no longer updated by Alibaba. Consider qwen-plus or qwen3-coder for better performance and continued support.

models.label: Qwen Long
models.description: Specialized for ultra-long document processing with a 10M token context window. Ideal for large-scale document analysis, extraction, summarization, and classification.

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models.description: Antigravity's default model. Outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on coding and agentic benchmarks while running ~4× faster than competing frontier models.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.description: Google's most capable Gemini 3.1 model. Best for the most complex reasoning and agentic coding tasks within Antigravity.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Anthropic's balanced model, available within Antigravity. Strong coding and agentic performance with adaptive thinking.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.6
models.description: Anthropic's high-capability Opus model, available within Antigravity. Best for demanding multi-step agentic and reasoning tasks.

models.label: GPT-OSS 120B
models.description: Open-weight 120B model available within Antigravity for self-hosted and open-model workflows.

models.label: Auto
models.description: Lets GitHub Copilot automatically route each request to the best available model. Recommended default for general coding and agentic work.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Anthropic's balanced Sonnet model and Copilot's strong general-purpose coding choice. Fast and reliable for everyday agentic tasks.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.description: Anthropic's latest Sonnet generation in Copilot. Balances speed and capability for day-to-day agentic coding.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8
models.description: Anthropic's high-capability Opus model. Best for the hardest reasoning, long-horizon agentic work, and complex multi-file changes.

models.label: GPT-5.4
models.description: OpenAI's frontier GPT-5.4 model in Copilot. Strong for complex code changes, research, and long-horizon work.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.description: OpenAI's latest frontier agentic coding model, available in Copilot. Best for ambitious long-horizon tasks.

models.label: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.description: Google's fast Gemini 3.6 Flash model in Copilot. Great for quick iterations and high-throughput agentic tasks.
